title: Freight
tagline: Draw the lines. The crates keep coming either way.
description: Depots appear across the map, each one making a shape and wanting a different one. You have three lines and a limited amount of track: connect the depots, let the trains shuttle, and keep the crates moving. Nothing here needs quick hands — it needs a network that still works when the map has doubled in size. When a depot backs up for too long, the whole thing stops.
author: HexCave
controls: Click a line colour, then click depots to route it
Right-click a line to clear it
howToPlay: Each depot is a shape, and it makes crates of other shapes that need taking somewhere.
Pick one of the three line colours at the bottom, then click depots in order to run that line through them. Clicking the last depot again shortens the line.
A line gets a train as soon as it connects two depots. The train shuttles back and forth on its own.
A train only picks up a crate if its line actually reaches a depot of that shape, so where you route matters more than how much track you lay.
Every line has a limited amount of track. Right-click a line to clear it and start that one again.
New depots keep appearing. When one backs up past eight crates it starts a timer, and if that runs out the whole network stops.
goal: Keep the network moving as the map grows. Crates delivered is the score, and your best is kept.
